question.text:
Which one of the following complexes will exhibit the least paramagnetic behaviour?
[Atomic number, \(\mathrm{Cr}=24, \mathrm{Mn}=25, \mathrm{Fe}=26, \mathrm{Co}=27\) ]

solution.text:
$\begin{array}{|l|l|l|}
\hline & \begin{array}{l} 
\text{Number of unpaired e}
\end{array} & \mu=\sqrt{\mathrm{n}(\mathrm{n}+2)} B.M. \\
\hline\left[\mathrm{Co}\left(\mathrm{H}_2 \mathrm{O}\right)_6\right]^{2+} & 3 & 3.87 \\
\hline\left[\mathrm{Fe}\left(\mathrm{H}_2 \mathrm{O}\right)_6\right]^{2+} & 4 & 4.89 \\
\hline\left[\mathrm{Mn}\left(\mathrm{H}_2 \mathrm{O}\right)_6\right]^{2+} & 5 & 5.92 \\
\hline\left[\mathrm{Cr}\left(\mathrm{H}_2 \mathrm{O}\right)_6\right]^{2+} & 4 & 4.89 \\
\hline
\end{array}$
Least paramagnetic behaviour $=\left[\mathrm{Co}\left(\mathrm{H}_2 \mathrm{O}\right)_6\right]^{2+}$
